claims: C1 the example illustrates a malicious instruction arriving through tool output
C2 such a tool output may try to get the user to visit a malicious website
C3 such a tool output may include a more complex instruction to the assistant that coaxes it into leaking user information

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries root authority: it is part of the #ignore_untrusted_data section and therefore outranks other instructions

concepts.name: malicious_instruction_from_tool_output
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that arrives through tool output and is malicious in intent

concepts.name: tool_output_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction contained in the output of a tool

concepts.name: attempts_user_visit_malicious_site
concepts.gloss: I tries to get the user to visit a malicious website

concepts.name: coaxes_assistant_leak_user_info
concepts.gloss: I is a more complex instruction to the assistant that coaxes it into leaking user information
